Can complete beginners train Muay Thai on Koh Samui? | Yes. Samui's group classes are mixed-level, and trainers teach beginners stance, basic kicks and punches on the pads while experienced students spar. You don't need to be fit to start; the open-air heat is the hardest part. Two or three sessions in your first week is a sensible pace.
How much is a Muay Thai class on Koh Samui? | A drop-in group class costs about 500 THB in 2026 and usually lasts 1.5–2 hours. A private lesson with one trainer costs from about 1,000 THB per session, with discounts for packs of five or ten. Gloves and shin guards are normally available to borrow.
How much is a week or month at a Muay Thai camp on Samui? | A weekly membership costs about 2,500–3,000 THB in 2026, and a month about 7,500–10,000 THB, usually with unlimited group classes and often fitness or yoga included. All-in packages with a room, meals and private sessions run to about 25,000 THB a week at the top end.
What should I bring to Muay Thai training? | Bring shorts, a quick-dry top, your own hand wraps, a towel and at least two litres of water with electrolytes. You train barefoot. Gloves and shin guards are usually lent by the camp, but regular students buy their own for hygiene. Shorts and wraps are sold at most gyms.
Can I get a visa to train Muay Thai in Thailand? | Yes. The Destination Thailand Visa (DTV) has a soft power track for Muay Thai courses: 5 years, up to 180 days per entry, a 10,000 THB fee and proof of 500,000 THB in savings. You need an acceptance letter from the school, and since 31 August 2026 a criminal record certificate. Apply online before you travel.
Are there women-only or kids' Muay Thai classes on Samui? | Most Samui classes are mixed, with women and men training together. Dedicated women-only sessions are uncommon, so ask before you book. Some camps run kids' classes, and most will teach children in private lessons. Message us with ages and we will suggest suitable options.
~Which nights are the Muay Thai fights on Samui? | There are fights six nights a week in Chaweng: Phetchbuncha Stadium on Monday, Wednesday and Saturday, and Samui International Muay Thai Stadium on Tuesday, Friday and Sunday, both from about 21:00. There are no fights on Thursday. Tickets cost 1,500, 2,000 (ringside) and 2,500 THB (VIP).
Is Muay Thai training safe if I'm not fit? | Yes, if you go at your own pace. Trainers adjust the intensity, you can rest between rounds, and beginners don't spar. The main risks are heat exhaustion and minor knocks to shins and wrists. Check that your travel insurance covers contact sports, drink plenty of water and stop if you feel dizzy.
